description: Source code for the 'clar' testing framework, including test execution, error handling, and platform-specific configurations.

classes.name: clar_error
classes.description: Represents an error encountered during a test, including file, function, line, message, and description.

classes.name: clar_explicit
classes.description: Represents explicit test suite and filter configuration.

classes.name: clar_report
classes.description: Stores information about individual test execution reports, including errors and status.

classes.name: clar_summary
classes.description: Handles summary file information and file pointer.

classes.name: clar_func
classes.description: Defines a test or setup/teardown function with name and pointer.

classes.name: clar_suite
classes.description: Defines a test suite with name, setup/teardown functions, list of tests, count, and enabled flag.

methods.name: clar_report_errors
methods.description: Reports all errors associated with a test report.

methods.name: clar_report_all
methods.description: Reports all failures across all test reports.

methods.name: clar_time_now
methods.description: Gets the current time for timing test execution, platform-specific.

methods.name: clar_time_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two timestamps, platform-specific.

methods.name: clar_run_test
methods.description: Runs an individual test, including setup, execution, timing, and cleanup.

methods.name: clar_run_suite
methods.description: Runs all tests within a specified suite, applying filters if provided.

methods.name: clar_usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the test runner.

methods.name: clar_parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure test execution.

methods.name: clar_test_init
methods.description: Initializes the testing environment, including argument parsing and summaries.

methods.name: clar_test_run
methods.description: Executes all configured tests and returns the total error count.

methods.name: clar_test_shutdown
methods.description: Cleans up after test execution, including freeing resources and writing summaries.

methods.name: clar_test
methods.description: Main entry point to run tests with command-line arguments.

methods.name: abort_test
methods.description: Handles aborting a test, either via longjmp or exit.
